title: Single-configuration localization-focused distillation into the selected 0.75x model
question: Can knowledge distillation from the pretrained 1.00x teacher recover independent-source (arm B) accuracy in the Phase 15 0.75x student without changing its inference architecture?
context: Phase 15 selected 0.75x (1,565,628 params, 2.707 GFLOPs) as equivalent to 1.00x within +/-1.5 AP.
Phase 16A LPWA-50 failed its AP gate; architecture work is closed.
Exploratory: COCO pretraining adds +3.9 AP on arm B vs +15.1 on exposed arm A.
Deficits are dominated by localization; conditional class correctness stays ~97%.

teacher.description: pretrained (COCO-init) YOLO11n 1.00x, runs_p4/r512 seed 0, fixed 24570-update checkpoint (not best-val); the model used in the exploratory pretraining analysis

student.init_policy: random initialisation exactly as Phase 15 w075 (yaml-built, pretrained=False, Ultralytics deterministic seeding with the run seed); the dry run verified identical initial state-dict hashes for the ordinary and KD trainers and that the first conv is not yolo11n.pt

baseline.runs: runs_p15/w075/seed0-4 (ordinary, non-distilled, already trained and scored)

training.source: configs/experiments.yaml [train], identical to runs_p4/r512 except init
training.note: identical to runs_p15/w075; the ONLY difference is the added KD loss

distillation.formula: L = L_box + L_cls + L_dfl  +  lam_ld * hyp.dfl * L_LD  +  lam_at * L_AT;  L_LD = mean over the student's TaskAlignedAssigner foreground anchors and the 4 box sides of KL( softmax(t/T) || softmax(s/T) ) * T^2 over the 16 DFL bins;  L_AT = sum over P3,P4 of mean_b || q_S - q_T ||_2^2 with q = vec(mean_c F^2)/||vec(mean_c F^2)||_2;  the total is multiplied by the batch size (Ultralytics convention)
distillation.lam_at_rule: lam_at = mean_{first 10 batches, ordinary trajectory, seed 0}(hyp.dfl*L_LD) / mean(L_AT), 3 significant figures; computed on training images only, before pre-registration
distillation.hook_points: Detect training output dict {boxes, scores, feats}: student box logits and neck P3/P4 feats are read directly (no hooks); teacher run in eval mode returns (y, dict) and the dict is used; assigner foreground mask from v8DetectionLoss.get_assigned_targets_and_loss
distillation.why_not_builtin: Ultralytics 8.4.155 ships DistillationModel (distill_model=...): P3/P4/P5 feature imitation with trainable projector MLPs weighted by teacher class scores, no box-distribution term. It is not localization-focused and adds P5, so it does not match this phase's design.

evaluation.arms: Phase 9 frozen arms over the official-val union (2439 images): arm B = source-INDEPENDENT (213 families, 411 files), arm A = source-EXPOSED (1047 families, 2028 files). Manifests/hashes: phase9/arm_freeze_record.json.
evaluation.inference: imgsz 512, conf 0.001, NMS IoU 0.7, max_det 300, top-100 per image
evaluation.scorer: pycocotools COCO AP@[.50:.95], maxDets 100, 8 categories (as Phase 9/12)
evaluation.decomposition: Phase 12 matching rules: conf 0.25, greedy one-to-one class-agnostic match at IoU 0.50; strict 0.75
evaluation.also: clean-val (268 originals) Ultralytics val at every checkpoint, descriptive only

primary.endpoint: six-class AP50-95 on arm B (213 independent families) at exactly 24570 updates
primary.comparison: kd075 vs ordinary w075, paired by seed
primary.statistic: Delta_i = AP_B(kd075, i) - AP_B(w075, i), i = 0..4
primary.rule: PASS iff mean Delta >= +0.75 AP AND the resource/architecture-identity gate holds
primary.reported: paired 95% t CI (df 4), per-seed deltas; significance not required

mechanism_gate: mean Delta localization recall @IoU .50 on arm B > 0 (expected direction). Reported as mechanistic corroboration; not part of PASS; no significance test.
resource_gate: per seed: params kd == base == 1,565,628; GFLOPs@512 equal; identical state-dict keys and shapes; checkpoint file size within 1%. Latency (GPU b1/b16, CPU b1) benchmarked on idle hardware; no speed-up is claimed because the inference graph is unchanged.
secondary: AP50, AP75, APs, AR100, class-agnostic AP, locR50, locR75, conditional class correctness, FP/family
arm A and arm B; exposed-minus-independent interaction (paired t and family bootstrap 1000)
vs 1.00x (Phase 15 one-sided margin -1.5) and vs the pretrained teacher family (context)
fraction of the pretrained-vs-0.75x gap recovered

stop_rules.fail: mean Delta AP_B < +0.75: Phase 17 FAILS. No second KD method, no alternate teacher, no alternate loss weights, no architecture modification, no rescue experiment.
stop_rules.pass: mean Delta AP_B >= +0.75 (and resource gate holds): Phase 17 PASSES; distilled 0.75x becomes the candidate deployment model; no further KD search.

integrity_rules: The clean test split is not inspected during development.
The margin and all rules are not changed after any result is seen.
Best-validation checkpoints are never the primary outcome; the primary is the fixed 24570-update checkpoint.
No edge-device speed claim is made from desktop GPU timings.
No Phase 17 AP is inspected during training (curves log losses and clean-val only; not read until post).
Coefficients are frozen; none is tuned on arm A, arm B or any Phase 17 result.
Clean test is opened once only, after Phase 17 finishes and final model selection is locked.

expected_compute.training_hours: 3.0-3.5 (5 x ~36-42 min; teacher forward adds a few %)
expected_compute.post_hours: ~1.0 (scoring 20 checkpoints ~35 min, bench ~5 min, stats ~25 min)
